claims.wording: On development questions, with two seeds, the ratio is below one third of the reference's at 95%. On held-out questions, the data support a ratio below two thirds of the reference's, with a point estimate below one third. Generalization appears between s5k and s10k: the neighbour generalizes at two thirds of the reference or more, and its ratio is above w*'s at 95%.

power.note: table and underpowered apply the window rule literally, including learning condition 3 (dN_c >= dN_ref/2, point estimates; prereg L172). At dN_c = dN_ref/2 condition 3 passes about half the time by construction, so the literal label tends to flag 'underpowered'. table_without_condition3 / underpowered_without_condition3 drop condition 3 and are a descriptive sensitivity only; only the literal label is used downstream (stageB power_labels). Learning condition 1 (N_bad) is not simulated; interpretability is assumed. Reference-only inputs: the table is the same for every early checkpoint.
